hooks.text: 白天以总统候选人身份争取民心，夜晚化身义警用武器清剿现任总统控制的犯罪帮派
hooks.excerpt: By day, you're a presidential candidate, winning the hearts and minds of the people. By night, you transform into a vigilante warrior, using your weapons to take down the criminal gangs controlled by the current president.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 各类敌人和副总统Boss拥有独特异常能力，击败他们后可以把这些能力夺为己用
hooks.excerpt: In a world filled with anomalies, you will encounter various enemies and vice president bosses, each with their own unique anomaly power. For example, did you know the president's PR chief has the power of HEART, making people fall in love with them?! The good news is, by defeating these bosses, you can acquire their anomaly powers!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 招募受压迫的Fluffies分配到竞选、装备升级或战斗部门，还要照顾成员，否则他们会离队甚至死亡
hooks.excerpt: Recruit the oppressed Fluffies to fight for their rights by joining your team. You can assign them to different departments: some will campaign for you during elections, others will upgrade your equipment, and some will assist you in battles. But remember if you want to benefit from them, you need to take good care of them. Otherwise, they might abandon you or worse, lose their lives.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
